config.adequate_target: At maximum K, >=90% conditional cells resolved AND max 95% half-width <=0.04; outer selected-surface state-block SE <=0.03 at N=1024. Report MIXED if any target fails.
config.classification: Present required; TRUE if all lower bounds strictly exceed theta; FALSE if absence or any upper bound strictly below theta; otherwise MC_UNRESOLVED
config.interval: Wilson score 95% pointwise Q1; Bonferroni two 97.5% Wilson components Q2; approximate binomial coverage, not simultaneous across cells
config.prefixes: Generate fixed maximum bank first; slice paired prefixes. No preferred-Boolean stopping.
config.publication_policy: Headline intervals attach to conditional finite-design units. Aggregate Health is a resolved-fraction bracket, not Health of an averaged state.
config.theta_endpoints: Full missingness theta=0/1 reported numerically unresolved when strict MC rule overlaps; deterministic absence still FALSE

distinction: Inner K study on fixed 16-state panel; outer N study uses K64. No claim of N1024 with K1024 everywhere.
systematic_limits: MC precision is not ecological validity or missingness/model/semantic uncertainty
